description_1line: UT Austin chemical engineering degree program (B.S., M.S., Ph.D.) whose own Graduate Program page names 'Advanced Materials, Polymers & Nanoengineering' among the McKetta Department of Chemical Engineering's six main research areas; the research-area page states active topics including design and control of polymers for microelectronics and biomedical applications and design of better membranes through nanocomposite technology.
notes: PACKET-LOCAL KEY NEW-UTA-CHE — program_id allocated by the integrator at integration, never here.
